  p.product_key,

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  dd.calendar_date,
  dd.fiscal_year,
  dd.fiscal_week,
  dd.fiscal_week_start_date,
  dd.fiscal_week_end_date,
  dd.day_name
FROM dim_date AS dd
WHERE dd.calendar_date >= '2026-10-01' AND dd.calendar_date <= '2026-10-15'
ORDER BY dd.calendar_date DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_week, fiscal_week_end_date 
FROM dim_date 
WHERE calendar_date >= '2026-09-01' AND calendar_date <= '2026-10-08'
ORDER BY fiscal_week_end_date DESC
LIMIT 2

SELECT 
  MAX(dd.calendar_date) AS max_date,
  MIN(dd.calendar_date) AS min_date
FROM dim_date AS dd

SELECT 
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  f.week_ending_date,
  f.closing_units
FROM fact_stock_week f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE f.store_key = 30 
  AND f.product_key = 11 
  AND f.week_ending_date = '2026-10-04'

  s.store_name,

  p.product_name,

INNER JOIN dim_product AS p ON fs.product_key = p.product_key

SELECT
  s.store_name,
  p.product_name,
  fs.week_ending_date,
  fs.closing_units AS units_in_stock
FROM fact_stock_week AS fs
INNER JOIN dim_store AS s ON fs.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product AS p ON fs.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE p.sku = 100011
  AND s.store_id = 124
  AND fs.week_ending_date = (SELECT MAX(week_ending_date) FROM fact_stock_week)
